description:
Who a holder is and how they file — the read on an adversary. Free.

    Computed from their whole register book: how much of it they let lapse, whether
    their marks cluster where they trade or spray across unrelated classes, and the
    leverage that gives counsel. Returns the evidence behind each finding; it draws no
    legal conclusions about the holder. Corporate identity from PermID comes with
    `attribution`, its CC BY 4.0 credit.
name: holder_read
title: Read a trademark holder
